name: player_resolve_pending_collision_contact
description: Player::ResolvePendingCollisionContact orients a pending collision normal, nudges player/probe position away from the hit, retries the probe sweep, computes bounce velocity and yaw impulse, and triggers local impact feedback when applicable.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player collision/contact source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and HLIL for 0x424270 validate saveState/contact fastcall ABI, contact normal orientation from sweepStart-hitPos, zero-XZ-normal early return, correction through zMath::Vec3Reflect and Player::Vec3_FastNormalize, modal probe translation, retry through TryResolvePendingCollisionProbeSweep, motion-basis X/Z cache update, bounce/tangent/normal velocity decomposition, airborne pickability restoration, local velocity rotation, yaw impulse, local-player SFX gain clamp, and zInput collision force-feedback dispatch.

The native smoke verifies the degenerate vertical-normal early return and a non-local collision path that translates player/probe positions, updates motionBasis X/Z, computes reflected projectile/local velocity, and applies the yaw impulse while avoiding SFX/force-feedback side effects.
